taxonomies_consolidated.name: Container Size and Dimensions
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to the size and dimensions of containers or packaging used for arts and crafts materials, e.g. small/mini size containers, compact storage solutions

taxonomies_consolidated.name: Product Quantity and Amount
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to the amount or quantity of arts and crafts materials provided, e.g. 1 onza/fistful amount of playdough, portion sizes

taxonomies_consolidated.name: Color Variety and Selection
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to the range and diversity of colors available in arts and crafts products, e.g. variety of colors available, multiple color options

taxonomies_consolidated.name: Color Vibrancy and Visual Appeal
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to the intensity, brightness, and visual attractiveness of colors in arts and crafts materials, e.g. super nice/vibrant colors, bright and bold colors, very pigmented colors

taxonomies_consolidated.name: Packaging Design and Structure
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to the design, appearance, and structural features of product packaging, e.g. sturdy and cute box packaging, caja con tapa abatible

taxonomies_consolidated.name: Packaging Condition and Integrity
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to the condition and physical state of packaging upon receipt, e.g. damaged/open packaging, compromised packaging integrity

taxonomies_consolidated.name: Material Safety and Composition
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to the safety characteristics and material composition of arts and crafts products, e.g. non-toxic and wheat-free materials, safe ingredients

taxonomies_consolidated.name: Writing Tip Performance Quality
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to the functional performance and quality of writing or drawing tips, e.g. smooth and even writing tip, consistent tip performance

taxonomies_consolidated.name: Tip Fragility and Breaking Issues
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to the tendency of tips to break or become damaged during use, e.g. tips break easily, fragile tip construction

taxonomies_consolidated.name: Tip Strength and Durability
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to the structural strength and durability of writing or drawing tips, e.g. strong tips, reinforced tip construction

taxonomies_consolidated.name: Tip Sharpness Degradation
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to how quickly tips lose their sharpness or become dull with use, e.g. tips get dull quickly, rapid sharpness loss

taxonomies_consolidated.name: Initial Tip Sharpness Quality
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to the sharpness condition of tips when the product is new or first used, e.g. not sharp at tips when new, initial tip condition
original_names: tips_not sharp at tips when new

taxonomies_consolidated.name: Pencil Shape and Structural Defects
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to structural deformities or shape issues in pencils, e.g. warped/curved pencils, bent or misshapen pencils

taxonomies_consolidated.name: Pencil Ergonomics and Comfort
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to how comfortable and ergonomic pencils are to hold and use, e.g. comfortable to hold, easy to grip

taxonomies_consolidated.name: Pencil Size and Dimensions
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to the physical size and dimensional characteristics of pencils, e.g. nice size pencil, appropriate pencil dimensions

taxonomies_consolidated.name: Color Application Texture and Smoothness
taxonomies_consolidated.definition: Physical aspect related to the texture and smoothness of color application from colored pencils, e.g. smooth texture when coloring, even color distribution
